title: Doggy Day Out on the Mornington Peninsula
summary: Self-guided pet-friendly day following digital clues across the Peninsula. Dog cafe with pup-approved snacks, human treats, and a relaxed winery picnic lunch. Runs Thursday to Sunday weekly.
suitableFor: Dog owners, couples with pets, pet-friendly group outings
accessibilityNotes: Self-guided route across multiple venues; accessibility varies by location
weatherDependency: Mostly outdoor; some indoor stops. Winter weather means layers for you and the dog.
nearbyAttractions: Mornington foreshore off-leash area; Balnarring Beach dog-friendly section; Peninsula dog-friendly wineries
suggestedItineraryPairing: Start with the digital trail, work through the dog cafe stop and picnic, finish at a dog-friendly beach for an afternoon run
editorVerdict: The Peninsula's best format for dog people. The digital trail structure keeps it interesting for the owners as much as the dogs.
editorNote:
Shire-backed self-guided experience that runs Thursday to Sunday. You follow digital clues across the Peninsula, stopping at a dog-specific cafe (pup snacks, human coffee), a picnic lunch at a winery that's set up for it, and whatever activity stops they've built into the route for that week.

Bring the dog, bring a light jacket for winter, book ahead so they know you're coming and have the picnic ready.

Not a children's event despite the name - it's designed for dog owners and runs on the assumption your dog is the main character of the day.
